digest.component_or_area: graph subsystem (blocker logic, cycle detection, unblock operations)
propositions: Four graph functions have excessive cyclomatic complexity (CCN 16-22): _find_direct_blockers (18), _get_all_blocked_by (20), check_cycle_at_level (16), detect_newly_unblocked (22).
Two identical "reduce_all → drop error/fsck → index by id" loops are duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, driving complexity.
Two BFS skeleton patterns (queue/visited bookkeeping with reduce_ticket and exception handling) are reimplemented in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level.
Refactoring introduces shared helpers load_indexed_states() and accumulator-returning bfs() to eliminate duplication while preserving behavior and node-sets.
Complexity baseline targets are _find_direct_blockers ≤ 8, _get_all_blocked_by ≤ 8, check_cycle_at_level ≤ 8, detect_newly_unblocked ≤ 12, with existing graph test suites as behavioral oracle.
Changes are low-risk: pure logic, mypy strictness ratchet enforced, extensive existing tests cover all four functions and related unblock operations.
